text:
sophia: Hey y'all — decluttering before the move. Free to a good home: 28" HP monitor (1080p, 75Hz, DP+HDMI), tiny scuff on the lower bezel but no dead pixels. Also throwing in a small mid-century style plant stand (oak veneer). Pickup from SF SOMA office (5th floor) or I can curb-drop Fri afternoon. Pics: https://img.example.com/monitor1973.jpg. DM to claim.

liam: Specs? VESA mount? speakers?

sophia: No built-in speakers, VESA 75x75 yes. Comes with DP cable. Serial sticker blurred in pic.

marcus: Interested in just the plant stand if someone wants the monitor.

jenny: I can take the monitor — can pick up Fri 3–5pm. @sophia want me to swing by or do you prefer curbside? :thumbsup:

liam: If jenny doesn't confirm I'll take it after 5.

sophia: Jenny confirmed — monitor is spoken for, leaving the plant stand open. Thanks everyone! :heart:

marcus: Sweet, I'll grab the plant stand. Can pick up Thu lunchtime.

logistics-bot: Reminder: office pickup must be scheduled on the shared calendar and follow the visitor policy link https://company.example.com/office-pickups — leave items in the lobby with a note.

sophia: Thanks @logistics-bot — I'll leave the plant stand by the 5th-floor mailroom with a sticky note that says "marcus". Monitor pickup arranged with jenny (Fri 3–5).

jenny: Got it — I'll text before I come. Thanks @sophia!

liam: GL to the new place, @sophia.

sophia: Thanks y'all :)
